name: inositol-trisphosphate 3-kinase B

function.text: ITPKB encodes inositol-trisphosphate 3-kinase B. Annotated molecular activities include inositol-1,4,5-trisphosphate 3-kinase activity and inositol hexakisphosphate kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and inositol phosphate biosynthetic process.
